records.jp: 記憶の欠片……
records.en_original: A memory shard...
records.en_auxiliary: A memory shard...
records.en: A memory shard...

records.jp: 見てみよう
records.en_original: Let's take a look!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's take a look!
records.en: Let's take a look.

records.jp: おい、なに廊下で突っ立ってんだよ？
records.en_original: Hey, what are you standing around in the hallway for?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, what are you standing around in the hallway for?
records.en: Hey, what are you standing around in the hallway for?

records.jp: なんだあ？　その荷物
records.en_original: The heck are you carrying?
records.en_auxiliary: The heck are you carrying?
records.en: What's with all that stuff?

records.jp: えっと……先生に、頼まれて……
records.en_original: Th-the teacher asked me to...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-the teacher asked me to...
records.en: Um...the teacher asked me to...

records.jp: 何だよパシリかよ。<CR>そんなフラフラでちゃんと運べんのかー？
records.en_original: Running errands? You teacher's pet! Can your little arms even handle it?
records.en_auxiliary: Running errands? You teacher's pet! Can your little arms even handle it?
records.en: What, running errands for the teacher?<CR>Can you even carry all that when you're wobbling around like that?

records.jp: あの暴力女にでも手伝ってもらえよ。<CR>って、もう転校したんだっけ。だははははは！！
records.en_original: Why don't you get that bodyguard of yours to help? Oh wait—she's not here anymore, is she? Hahahaha!
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you get that bodyguard of yours to help? Oh wait—she's not here anymore, is she? Hahahaha!
records.en: Why don't you get that violent girl to help you?<CR>Oh, right, she transferred. Dahahahaha!!

records.jp: きー！　ムカつくなあこいつら！
records.en_original: Ugh! Those brats!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh! Those brats!
records.en: Ugh! Those jerks are so annoying!

records.jp: これ、詩帆ちゃんが転校してすぐの頃だ。<CR>わたし、どうしたんだっけ……
records.en_original: This has to be right after Shiho transferred. What did I do...?
records.en_auxiliary: This has to be right after Shiho transferred. What did I do...?
records.en: This was right after Shiho-chan transferred.<CR>What did I do again...?

records.jp: え……っと……。その……
records.en: Um...well...

records.jp: あ？　何だよ
records.en_original: What? You got something to say?
records.en_auxiliary: What? You got something to say?
records.en: Huh? What?

records.jp: 言いたいことがあるなら言ってみろよ
records.en_original: Come on, spit it out!
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, spit it out!
records.en: If you have something to say, spit it out.

records.jp: 手伝って……もらえない？
records.en_original: W-would you...help me?
records.en_auxiliary: W-would you...help me?
records.en: Could you...help me?

records.jp: はあ！？　何で俺たちが！
records.en_original: What?! Why would we do that?!
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Why would we do that?!
records.en: What?! Why should we?!

records.jp: わたし一人だと大変で……。<CR>手伝ってくれたら、すごく嬉しい……のです
records.en_original: It's a lot for me to carry, and...it would make me very happy if you did.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a lot for me to carry, and...it would make me very happy if you did.
records.en: It's too much for me alone...<CR>I would be very happy...if you helped me.

records.jp: いや、だって、それはおまえ……。<CR>頼むにしたって、なんで俺たちに……
records.en_original: Huh? That's...that's your job. Why would you ask us?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? That's...that's your job. Why would you ask us?
records.en: I mean, that's...<CR>Even if you need help, why ask us...?

records.jp: おい、こいつなんかほっといてもう行こうぜ
records.en_original: Hey, come on. Let's get out of here.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, come on. Let's get out of here.
records.en: Hey, forget her. Let's go.

records.jp: ダメ……かな？
records.en_original: So... You won't?
records.en_auxiliary: So... You won't?
records.en: Is that...a no?

records.jp: ……わーったよ！　手伝ってやる！<CR>今回だけだからな！
records.en_original: Ugh, fine! Just this once, got it?!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, fine! Just this once, got it?!
records.en: ...Fine! I'll help you!<CR>Just this once, got it?!

records.jp: はあああ！！？？
records.en_original: What?!
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: WHAAAT?!

records.jp: ……！　ありがとう！
records.en_original: Th-thank you!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thank you!
records.en: ...! Thank you!

records.jp: う……うっせえな！　さっさと貸せよ！
records.en_original: Sh-shut up! Just gimme that box!
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-shut up! Just gimme that box!
records.en: Sh-shut up! Hurry up and hand it over!

records.jp: あれ、なんか丸く収まってる……？
records.en_original: What...? That's how you resolved it...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...? That's how you resolved it...?
records.en: Huh? Somehow that worked out...?

records.jp: そっか、思い出した……
records.en_original: Oh, I remember now...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I remember now...
records.en: Oh, right. I remember now...

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃんに「もっと人に頼らなきゃ」って言われて、<CR>どうしたらいいか悩んでた
records.en_original: I had no idea how to rely on others like Shiho told me to.
records.en_auxiliary: I had no idea how to rely on others like Shiho told me to.
records.en: Shiho-chan told me I had to rely on people more,<CR>and I was struggling to figure out how.

records.jp: でもある時勇気を出して、今までいじわるしてきてた<CR>男の子たちに頼ってみたの
records.en_original: But one day, I mustered up the courage to ask for help from the boys who had been bullying me.
records.en_auxiliary: But one day, I mustered up the courage to ask for help from the boys who had been bullying me.
records.en: But one day, I worked up the courage to ask the boys<CR>who had always bullied me for help.

records.jp: それはまた、思い切った事したねえ……
records.en_original: That was pretty brave of you.
records.en_auxiliary: That was pretty brave of you.
records.en: That was quite a bold thing to do...

records.jp: わたし、人と争ったりするの、苦手だから……。<CR>だったら、仲良くなるしかないって思って
records.en_original: I really don't like conflict, so I figured the only way forward was to try to be friends.
records.en_auxiliary: I really don't like conflict, so I figured the only way forward was to try to be friends.
records.en: I don't like fighting with people...<CR>so I thought my only choice was to become friends with them.

records.jp: でも、それがうまく行ったんだ
records.en_original: And it looks like that worked out well for you.
records.en_auxiliary: And it looks like that worked out well for you.
records.en: And it worked.

records.jp: （ていうか、あのいじめっ子の男子の反応……。<CR>もしかしたら、本当はこころのことが……）
records.en_original: (The way that one boy reacted, though... I think he had a crush on Kokoro.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The way that one boy reacted, though... I think he had a crush on Kokoro.)
records.en: (But judging by the way that boy reacted...<CR>maybe he actually liked Kokoro...)

records.jp: うん……。それから、学校の他のみんなとも普通に<CR>話せるようになって、友達もたくさんできた
records.en_original: It did. After that, I started talking to the other kids at school more and made lots of friends.
records.en_auxiliary: It did. After that, I started talking to the other kids at school more and made lots of friends.
records.en: Yeah... After that, I started talking normally<CR>with everyone else at school too, and I made lots of friends.

records.jp: 良かった、ちゃんと思い出せた……
records.en_original: I'm so glad I remember now...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so glad I remember now...
records.en: Thank goodness. I was able to remember it...

records.jp: よくない！！！
records.en_original: NO!!!
records.en_auxiliary: NO!!!
records.en: NO!!!

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!

records.jp: なんで……。<CR>なんであんなやつらと仲良くしなきゃいけないの！
records.en_original: Why... Why do I have to be friends with them?!
records.en_auxiliary: Why... Why do I have to be friends with them?!
records.en: Why...?<CR>Why do I have to be friends with people like them?!

records.jp: わたしにも、詩帆ちゃんにも……。<CR>たくさんひどいことした、あんなやつらと！
records.en_original: They did so many horrible things to Shiho and me!
records.en_auxiliary: They did so many horrible things to Shiho and me!
records.en: People who did so many horrible things<CR>to me and Shiho-chan?!

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: That's...

records.jp: これって、ちっちゃい頃のこころ……？
records.en_original: Is this a younger version of you, Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this a younger version of you, Kokoro?
records.en: Is this...Kokoro when she was little?

records.jp: （そっか……。こころだって、受けた仕打ちを<CR>全部許せてたわけじゃない）
records.en_original: (I see... Of course Kokoro wouldn't have been able to forgive all of the things they'd done to her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I see... Of course Kokoro wouldn't have been able to forgive all of the things they'd done to her.)
records.en: (I see... Even Kokoro<CR>hadn't forgiven everything they did to her.)

records.jp: （こういう感情だって、あったはず）
records.en_original: (It makes sense that she would have feelings like this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It makes sense that she would have feelings like this.)
records.en: (She must have had feelings like this too.)

records.jp: 答えて！！<CR>どうしてこんなことしなくちゃいけないの！！
records.en_original: Answer me! Why do I have to do this?!
records.en_auxiliary: Answer me! Why do I have to do this?!
records.en: Answer me!!<CR>Why do I have to do something like this?!

records.jp: だって、それは……
records.en_original: B-because...
records.en_auxiliary: B-because...
records.en: Because...well...

records.jp: こころ
records.en_original: Kokoro.
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro.
records.en: Kokoro.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……？
records.en: Ao-chan...?

records.jp: 大丈夫。今のこころなら、ちゃんと答えを出せるはず
records.en_original: Don't worry. I know that you, as the person you are now, can give her the answer she needs.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. I know that you, as the person you are now, can give her the answer she needs.
records.en: It's okay. The Kokoro you are now should be able to find an answer.

records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah.

records.jp: わたし、戦うのは苦手だから……。<CR>だから、みんなと仲良くなれたらって、そう思ったの
records.en_original: Because I don't like to fight. That's why I tried to be friends with everybody around me.
records.en_auxiliary: Because I don't like to fight. That's why I tried to be friends with everybody around me.
records.en: I don't like fighting...<CR>so I thought I should try to become friends with everyone.

records.jp: それが、たとえどんな相手でも……
records.en_original: No matter who they were.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter who they were.
records.en: No matter who they were...

records.jp: わたしの言ってることは、間違いだって言うの……？
records.en_original: Are you saying it's wrong to feel the way I do?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you saying it's wrong to feel the way I do?
records.en: Are you saying I'm wrong...?

records.jp: ううん。そういう気持ちだって、あって当然
records.en_original: No, not at all. It's completely natural for you to feel this way.
records.en_auxiliary: No, not at all. It's completely natural for you to feel this way.
records.en: No. Of course it's natural to feel that way.

records.jp: いっぱいひどいこともされたし、<CR>辛い気持ちになることもあったよ
records.en_original: They did a lot of mean things, and made us feel terrible.
records.en_auxiliary: They did a lot of mean things, and made us feel terrible.
records.en: They did a lot of horrible things to us,<CR>and there were times we felt deeply hurt.

records.jp: でも、相手を憎んだり、恨んだり、やり返したり……<CR>そっちの方が、わたしにはもっと辛い
records.en_original: But hating them, or holding a grudge, or trying to get even... That would make me feel even worse.
records.en_auxiliary: But hating them, or holding a grudge, or trying to get even... That would make me feel even worse.
records.en: But hating them, resenting them, getting revenge...<CR>those things would be even more painful for me.

records.jp: もし、そんな相手にも歩み寄って、<CR>仲良くできたなら……それが一番だって、そう思う
records.en_original: The best thing you can do for yourself is to understand and get along with everyone, even people like him. That's what I believe.
records.en_auxiliary: The best thing you can do for yourself is to understand and get along with everyone, even people like him. That's what I believe.
records.en: If I could meet even people like that halfway<CR>and become friends with them...I think that would be best.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: みんなと仲良くなりたい、っていう気持ちが、<CR>今のこころに繋がってるんだね
records.en_original: That desire to be friends with everyone is still in you now, Kokoro.
records.en_auxiliary: That desire to be friends with everyone is still in you now, Kokoro.
records.en: Your desire to become friends with everyone<CR>is what led to the Kokoro you are today.

records.jp: うん。<CR>でも……愛央ちゃんはその中でも特別だよ
records.en_original: Yes, it is. But of all my friends, Ao...you are the most special one.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, it is. But of all my friends, Ao...you are the most special one.
records.en: Yeah.<CR>But...you're special to me even among all of them, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 特別……？
records.en_original: Special?
records.en_auxiliary: Special?
records.en: Special...?

records.jp: わたしが不安になった時、傍にいてくれて、<CR>お話を聞いてくれて……
records.en_original: You always stand by me when I'm upset. You always listen to what I have to say.
records.en_auxiliary: You always stand by me when I'm upset. You always listen to what I have to say.
records.en: When I feel anxious, you stay by my side<CR>and listen to me...

records.jp: そして、手を握って励ましてくれて。<CR>本当に……本当にありがとう
records.en_original: And you always hold my hand and encourage me. I really, really appreciate you.
records.en_auxiliary: And you always hold my hand and encourage me. I really, really appreciate you.
records.en: And you hold my hand and encourage me.<CR>Thank you...really, truly.

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんはわたしの大切な親友、なのです
records.en_original: You truly are an important friend to me, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You truly are an important friend to me, Ao.
records.en: Ao-chan, you're my precious best friend.
